value.rationale: Root outdegree measures primary branching and internal path length measures global tree depth, standard but distinct observables in Catalan/Galton–Watson conditioning. The exact all-size covariance sign, finite coefficient formula, and sharp linear negative scale answer their previously unreported mixed-dependence question. This is more than a normalization change or parameter substitution: marginal root-degree and path-length theories do not determine their mixed moment. It is a self-contained exact finite-size structural law with a plausible use in joint shape diagnostics; no downstream theorem is claimed.
